summary.text: Justin Fleming is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 105 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously worked as a director of government affairs.

paragraphs.text: Justin Fleming was born in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Susquehanna Township High School in 1998.
He earned a bachelor's degree in speech communication from Millersville University in 2002.
His career experience includes working as a director of government affairs.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a local elected official and child and mental health advocate who had spent 11 years working with members of the General Assembly and staff on legislation.
Fleming succeeded Andrew Lewis in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, assuming office on December 1, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session, he served on the Aging and Older Adult Services, House Appropriations, Children and Youth, and House Local Government committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
